# LANTERN ROAD
*Folk ballad — pasted lyrics with no Style or Lyrics headings*

[Extended Instrumental Intro — Fingerpicked Guitar]

[Verse 1 — Low, Close]

The lantern swung beside the gate
The road was white with frost
I kept the window lit all night
For something that was lost

[Chorus]

Come home along the lantern road
Come home before the snow

[Final Refrain — Warm]

The lantern swung beside the gate
And then the light was gone

[End]
